differences.title: 1. DEVELOPMENT SPEED
differences.leftDesc: Build interfaces quickly with pre-defined classes, less context switching.
differences.rightDesc: Requires writing custom CSS, can be slower for complex UIs.

differences.title: 2. CUSTOMIZATION
differences.leftDesc: Customize design tokens and extend with utility variants.

differences.title: 3. CODE REUSE
differences.leftDesc: Style components by composing utility classes.

differences.title: 4. LEARNING CURVE
differences.leftDesc: Learn utility classes, less CSS theory.
differences.rightDesc: Requires understanding CSS selectors, specificity, cascade.

differences.title: 5. FILE SIZE
differences.leftDesc: Purges unused styles, resulting in small production bundles.
differences.rightDesc: Can grow large if not managed well.

differences.title: 6. MAINTAINABILITY
differences.leftDesc: Ensures consistent design language across the project.
differences.rightDesc: Can become complex and hard to maintain at scale.

differences.title: 7. INTEGRATION
differences.leftDesc: Works with any JavaScript framework or static site.
